business_updates: **Results season** -- 387 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) -- tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here (baseline's own count).

**Baheti Recycling Industries** -- H1 FY27 revenue up 67.69% YoY to Rs 528.47 cr, EBITDA up 99.48% to Rs 42.37 cr, PAT up 105.83% to Rs 19.08 cr; raises FY28 revenue guidance to Rs 1,300+ cr from Rs 1,100 cr.

**Capillary Technologies** -- Q2 FY27 operating revenue up 51% YoY (43% constant-currency) to Rs 271.35 cr, Adjusted EBITDA up 103% YoY to Rs 44.86 cr, PAT swings to Rs 21.92 cr from Rs 0.29 cr a year ago.
**Devyani International** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 10.4% YoY to Rs 1,519 cr, Operating EBITDA up 34% YoY to Rs 229 cr, PBT of Rs 5.7 cr against a loss a year ago; 70 net new stores added, led by KFC.
**Puravankara** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 59% YoY to Rs 1,051 cr, PAT of Rs 82 cr against a Rs 42 cr loss a year ago; pre-sales up 109% to Rs 2,762 cr, net debt down Rs 470 cr in the quarter.
**Arvind Fashions** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 10.0% YoY to Rs 1,559 cr (its highest ever), EBITDA up 15.5% to Rs 216 cr, PAT up 29.6% to Rs 49 cr.
**Krsnaa Diagnostics** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 32% YoY to its highest ever Rs 271 cr; H1 FY27 revenue up 27% to Rs 506.5 cr, PAT down to Rs 41.1 cr on upfront Rajasthan-project spend.
**Balmer Lawrie & Co** -- announces its Q2 FY27 results (figures carried in the Results tab).

**Blue Cloud Softech Solutions** -- SpaceX International accepts October services under its already-disclosed $150 mn SOW (9-Jul MSA, 8-Aug SOW), invoicing $10 mn (~Rs 95 cr) for the month against accepted deliverables; no new order today.

**Lloyds Engineering Works** -- H1 FY27 consolidated revenue up ~110% YoY to Rs 1,120.70 cr, EBITDA up 72.3% to Rs 158.76 cr; consolidated order book up to Rs 4,591.67 cr from Rs 1,580.99 cr a year earlier.
**Bajaj Auto** -- October total sales (2W+CV) of 5,91,876 units, up 14% YoY (domestic 3,51,148, +12%; exports 2,40,728, +18%).
**Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone** -- October port cargo volume of 51 MMT, up 27% YoY, led by dry cargo (+36%); YTD Oct cargo up 16% YoY to 331 MMT.
**Steel Strips Wheels** -- October net turnover up 55.58% YoY to Rs 647.05 cr, its fourth straight month of record sales, led by Aluminium (+66% YoY) and CV wheels (+53% YoY).
**Ashok Leyland** -- October total vehicle sales (domestic) of 20,224 units, up 24% YoY (M&HCV trucks +39% to 11,102).
**Atul Auto** -- October domestic three-wheeler sales of 3,560 units, roughly flat YoY (+0.48%; IC-engine +9.23%, EV -23.29%).
**Lupin** -- receives US FDA approval for Amifampridine Tablets; no financial figures disclosed.
